axes: x east, y north, z up. Map (0, 0) is the point gate_config places at origin_lat_deg, origin_lon_deg; x and y are east and north on the tangent plane there (gate_map_to_geodetic converts). z is altitude above sea level minus origin_alt_m.

extent.outside: no obstacles; an escape that leaves the extent counts as clear

terrain.layout: row j is y = y0 + j * spacing (south to north), column i is x = x0 + i * spacing (west to east); heights are float32 written in shortest round-trip form
terrain.interpolation: each grid square splits along its south-west to north-east diagonal: with u = (x - x_i) / spacing and v = (y - y_j) / spacing, h = h00 + u (h10 - h00) + v (h11 - h10) if u >= v, else h00 + v (h01 - h00) + u (h11 - h01), where h10 is one step east and h01 one step north; positions outside the grid clamp to its edge

buildings.shape: axis-aligned boxes [x_min, x_max] x [y_min, y_max] x [z_min, z_max]; a tower is several stacked boxes with the same lot; z_min is below the terrain

streets.note: street centre lines run north-south at x = axis and east-west at y = axis inside the city (|x|, |y| <= 1200); the street escape climbs along them

raster: the filter also checks a 2.5 m max-height raster derived from the above: over each 2400 x 2400 cell starting at (x0, y0), the maximum of the terrain at the cell's four corners and of z_max for every box overlapping the cell

clearance.note: an escape is verified only if the body sphere and the wing capsule keep margin metres from terrain and boxes along it
